_doc: Battle tuning (openspec/changes/battle-console-engine/design.md section 3), from the battle console mockup (v65). Every number is a placeholder until the combat change. Every distance is ten times the mockup's (owner, 2026-11-06: "1km -> 10km"), and ship_frame_x frames each ship at ten times its length_m, so the battle looks as it did: a ship is drawn, and its mounts, ramming and rock strikes are measured, at that framed length. ai_close_after_s: an AI captain whose fire has not landed for that long closes in to half its fighting range, and to half again for every further ai_close_after_s without a hit (an eighth at most), so a ship never kites at a range where its shots are all decoyed, missed or out of reach (Mac playtest 2026-11-08: a Vos corsair circling a Krai corvette at 49 km for the whole battle). intercept_max_lead_deg: the most an intercept leads its target off the nose, so the forward arcs keep it (a Krai corvette leading a circling corsair 50 km out had it outside its 70 degree arcs). stalemate_s: a battle that cannot be withdrawn from (a story or special mission) where no ship has been hurt for that long ends as a stalemate, graded as a withdrawal (a draw). ai_range_*_km: an AI captain's fighting distance, brought in 2026-11-11 (owner: "it seems like enemy bots are really weak, why arent they shooting back?"): at 80 km a lance hits about half the time and the enemy sat beyond the player's closing fleet; at 50 km it trades fire where it hits.
